Akasa Air Plans Significant Capacity Expansion for FY27

Akasa Air, an Indian airline, has announced plans to increase its capacity by 30% in the fiscal year 2027. This expansion comes as the airline reported reduced losses in FY26 compared to the previous year, despite a 30% increase in capacity during that period. The airline's strategy indicates a focus on growth, seemingly undeterred by broader industry caution.
